wholePhysicalScope: Three connected named building envelopes and three open mapped convent courtyards. Seven mapped dome controls, including six aisle cupolas. The remaining round mapped roof feature sits within the bell-tower footprint at the documented Camaná and Conde de Superunda corner.
lodDetails: All levels retain the octagonal bell tower, nave and cupolas, chapel and the three open cloisters. Street and close-up add balcony rails, carved profiles and arcade tile panels.
limitations: Represents the standing basilica, Veracruz chapel, bell tower and three enclosed convent courts. Details of the porticos and tower follow the verified historical architectural record.
The documented tower height and mapped outlines anchor the exterior. The tower footprint within the corner, dormers, cloister bay counts, rear openings and minor courtyard details are estimated.

Restored wall tints are approximated from documented contemporary site colors. Tower carving, gallery marbling and tile patterns are simplified. The original local elevation field is preserved, with approximate thresholds.
